messages:
elaine_support: Customer ACME on Dedicated reports repetitive parse failures when response_format=structured_json and strict=true. They see invalid JSON when auth rotates and when upstream returns a 302/HTML. Repro attached.

brian_dev: Can you paste the exact curl they used?

elaine_support: They used:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxx" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-4-large","input":"summarize: ...","response_format":"structured_json","strict":true}'
```
Response sometimes is 200 with HTML error like `<html>...billing update...</html>` which breaks client JSON parsing.

carol_prod: Did they have an auth rotate event/time-based key expiry? We had a short outage at 2026-01-12 03:14 UTC that returned a 302 for some internal auth flows.

dave_engineer: This sounds like two issues: (1) upstream auth/billing fallback returning non-JSON, (2) our content-negotiation precedence where Accept header vs response_format may pick a rendered error page. We should reproduce with a mocked 401 and 429.

elaine_support: Repro steps I recorded:
1) start with valid key
2) send 5k tokens request with response_format=structured_json & strict=true
3) rotate key mid-request (simulate 401), or push billing flag to "payment_required" for org
Observed: client got 200/JSON sometimes, but also 200+HTML or 401 HTML page depending on routing. Client SDK then logs JSON parse error.

brian_dev: Quick check: do we set Content-Type on the error path? If error middleware returns HTML with Content-Type:text/html we should still enforce response_format by returning a structured error JSON if strict=true.

dave_engineer: Agreed. Proposed action: (A) short-term: set gateway to prefer response_format enforcement: if request includes response_format and strict==true -> transform any error pages into structured error payload with status and error_type. (B) add a guard to SDKs to fail-on-non-json when strict set. (C) create repro harness and cron to hit dedicated pools under auth rotation.

elaine_support: Customer wants workaround now. Suggested: set strict=false OR add `Accept: application/vnd.redwood.structured+json` header which we've started honoring in a feature flag. They tried Accept before and sometimes gateway ignored it.

deploy_bot: deploy: rollout/response-format-enforce -> started canary on dedicated-east-1 at 2026-02-02T14:22Z

carol_prod: I'll escalate to SRE to confirm no side-effects. tagging @dave_engineer for rollout verification. :crossed_fingers:

brian_dev: Filing support ticket to customer with repro and recommended temporary flags. Also adding logs to trace response Content-Type and body-start (first 512 bytes) for incidents.

elaine_support: thanks team. I'll update ACME and keep thread open until after canary.
